court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Smt. Radhika W/O. Anup Gupta vs Anup S/O. Sharadkumar Gupta
facts_of_case: The petitioners challenged the order granting maintenance pendente lite to the wife.

legal_principles.principle: The quantum of maintenance pendente lite should be commensurate to the standard of living and status of the parties.
legal_principles.held: This Court had earlier remanded the matter for deciding the application for grant of maintenance pendente lite afresh by observing that the quantum of maintenance should be commensurate to the standard of living and status of the parties.
cited_cases: Smt. Radhika W/O. Anup Gupta vs Anup S/O. Sharadkumar Gupta, (2024) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: The wife is entitled to a life with the same standard of living as that of her husband.
legal_principles.held: She submitted that the wife is entitled for a life with the same standard of living as that of her husband and considering the solid financial position of the husband, grant of amount of Rs.25,000/- per month towards maintenance pendente lite is very meagre.

outcome.final_order: Rule made returnable forthwith and heard finally with consent of the learned counsel for the parties.
